title: Will the U.S. Supreme Court grant certiorari in a case primarily concerning tribal sovereignty or Indian Country jurisdiction during OT2026?
resolutionCriteria: Resolves YES if SCOTUSblog's case docket or Turtle Talk (Michigan State University Indian Law blog) reports a grant of certiorari in a case whose primary question presented concerns tribal sovereignty, Indian Country criminal/civil jurisdiction, or federal Indian law, docketed for the October 2026 term, by 2026-12-31; NO otherwise.
falsifier: Wrong if SCOTUSblog's or Turtle Talk's own reporting on cert grants for OT2026 disagrees with the recorded probability's implied side.
